Run all Line 1.2 general enrollment analyses

Source: R/run_general_enrollment_analysis.R
run_general_enrollment_analysis.Rd

Orchestrates the enrollment sub-analyses (counts, proportions, subgroup transitions, entry/exit performance, and school/district aggregations) and returns a single named results list. Mirrors run_general_trend_analysis() in structure so both results objects can be saved and passed to their respective report templates independently.

Usage

run_general_enrollment_analysis(
  student_results_long,
  assessment_spec,
  report_years = NULL,
  subgroup_vars = NULL,
  min_n = 10
)

Arguments

student_results_long

A long-format student results data frame (see data contract). Should already be processed by standardize_student_results().

assessment_spec

Named list describing the assessment program (see assessment_spec).

report_years

Integer vector of years to include. NULL (default) uses all years present in the data.

subgroup_vars

Character vector of demographic column names to use as subgroups. NULL (default) uses all variables in assessment_spec$demographics. Pass an explicit vector (e.g. c("IEP", "LEP", "FRL", "GENDER")) to restrict the analysis.

min_n

Integer. Minimum group size for small-n suppression across all sub-analyses. Default 10.

Value

A named list general_enrollment_results with sub-lists:

  • $counts — enrollment counts at various grains (overall, by year, by grade, by subject, by subgroup, by school, by district)

  • $proportions — subgroup proportions (by year, by grade, by school)

  • $transitions — named by subgroup variable; year-over-year composition shifts and summaries from compute_subgroup_transitions()

  • $entry_exit — performance of entering and exiting students

  • $aggregate — school- and district-level enrollment summaries

  • $text — narrative summary from summarize_enrollment()

  • $params — list of run parameters (min_n, report_years)

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
source(system.file("specs/00_DEMO_Assessment_Spec.R", package = "ReportR"))
general_enrollment_results <- run_general_enrollment_analysis(
  student_results_long = demo_data,
  assessment_spec      = assessment_spec
)
general_enrollment_results$counts$by_year
general_enrollment_results$proportions$by_subgroup
} # }
